content: For each natural number k, let <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.357ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="2.639ex" height="1.952ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -705 1166.4 862.8" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><g data-mml-node="msub"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D436" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D436"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(748,-150) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="1D458" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D458"></use></g></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> denote the circle with radius k centimetres and centre at the origin. On the circle <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.357ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="2.639ex" height="1.952ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -705 1166.4 862.8" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><g data-mml-node="msub"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D436" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D436"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(748,-150) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="1D458" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D458"></use></g></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>, a-particle moves k centimetres in the counter-clockwise direction. The motion of the patticle continues in the manner. The particle starts at (1, 0).
